title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-16
lineage: MAC (modified Nakamichi CM-700 mics > Sony TC-D5M on Maxell metal tape, about 20 feet in front of the soundboard) > Nak Dragon playback > Cardas audiophile cables > HHB CDR 800 master CD > Samsung SW-232B extraction (EAC v0.9 beta

ai_review.summary: Decent audience‑sourced recording of a mixed‑energy 80s show; sound is okay but not soundboard quality.
ai_review.review: The show has its moments and is praised as a solid 80s performance, though some listeners find the set overly heavy on cowboy‑style songs. The recording is an audience (or matrix) capture – decent and crisp in places but marred by hiss, possible Dolby processing and occasional muffling, so it falls short of true soundboard clarity.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews give an average of ~3 stars; comments show a blend of positive and negative impressions for both performance and audio quality, leading to a middle‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Decent but not great clarity; some analogue hiss and possible Dolby processing noted, occasional muffling of band amid audience noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Mixed feelings – praised as a solid 80s show but criticized for being overly full of cowboy‑style songs.
